name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors.
eligibilityText: Age 18+, Minimum 8th pass for projects above ₹10L in manufacturing.
requiredDocuments: Rural Area Certificate from Gram Panchayat

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Shishu Category
description: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹50,000 for small businesses and self-employed individuals.
eligibilityText: Any Indian citizen with a viable non-farm revenue proposal.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM SHG Credit
description: Subsidized interest rate loans (at 7% per annum) for Self Help Group women entrepreneurs.
eligibilityText: Active member of a registered Panchasutra SHG for over 6 months.
requiredDocuments: SHG Resolution Letter signed by office bearers
